messages:
Ravi: opening a coordination thread 1429/timeout troubleshooting doc PR. i consolidated examples into a single 'troubleshooting matrix' but i haven't updated SDK examples or redirect links yet. need a quick triage.

Claire: i can pick up the JS and python snippets. were there breaking anchor changes?

Ravi: yes a couple anchors under /guides/errors moved when we refactored the timeouts page. falling links flagged by the link-checker.

Tom: i updated the ruby example for backoff semantics yesterday. will check for parity with JS. also flagged that streaming fallback sample omits error-class checks.

Jordan: DocsBot shows link-check failed on the branch head earlier. Logs attached in the PR.

DocsBot: ci/link-checker 1: failed (2 anchors missing). details: https://ci.example.com/build/10123

Claire: i'll rewrite the JS retry example to include honoring `Retry-After` header and a short note about not retrying on idempotent stream fragments.

Tom: i'll add the missing streaming fallback guard and push a tiny sample file to /sdk/shared/streaming-fallback.md and then create a redirect from the old path.

Ravi: plan: i want to merge the matrix table now since it's purely editorial. snippet and redirect fixes can land in a follow-up PR. if the link-check is green before EOD i'll combine.

Claire: agree. i'll open a small PR for JS/python snippets and tag reviewers. trying to finish in the next 2 hours.

Tom: pushed streaming sample and redirect commit. PTAL.

DocsBot: ci/link-checker 1: success (0 broken anchors) 1: https://ci.example.com/build/10127

Ravi: merging the matrix now. leaving TODOs in the matrix for snippet PR numbers and linking to the new streaming example. thanks all.

Jordan: thanks team, can we also add a one-line entry to the docs changelog noting snippet updates? makes audits easier.

Claire: added changelog line in the snippet PR body.

Tom: done.

Ravi: nice. merging. will monitor the error-handling page in production for any regressions.
